sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: MID-LEVEL SHORT-WAVE TROUGH MOVING ACROSS THE UPPER MS VALLEY/UPPER GREAT LAKES REGION AT THE START OF THE PERIOD IS PROGGED TO DIG WEAKLY ESEWD WITH TIME. AS IT DOES...WEAK SURFACE FRONT WILL SHIFT EWD ACROSS THE NORTHEAST/SEWD ACROSS THE MIDWEST WITH TIME...WHILE LAGGING NWWD ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS THROUGH THE PERIOD. THIS FRONT AND ASSOCIATED WEAK UPPER TROUGHING E OF THE ROCKIES WILL BE CONTRIBUTORS TO THE PRIMARY SEVERE WEATHER THREAT THIS PERIOD.

sections.title: NRN HIGH PLAINS SEWD INTO MO
sections.text: ONGOING CONVECTION OVER THE CENTRAL PLAINS WILL LIKELY BE WEAKENING EARLY IN THE PERIOD...WITH THE SURFACE BAROCLINIC ZONE PROGGED TO SHARPEN THROUGH THE DAY FROM THE NRN HIGH PLAINS SEWD ACROSS KS AND INTO THE OZARKS. WITH HEATING/DESTABILIZATION OCCURRING ALONG THE FRONT THROUGH THE AFTERNOON...EXPECT STORMS TO REDEVELOP -- LIKELY ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS INITIALLY AND THEN SEWD ALONG THE FRONT AS STORMS SHIFT OFF THE HIGHER TERRAIN AND MOVE SEWD INTO KS AND VICINITY. WITH 40 KT WLYS ALOFT ATOP LOW-LEVEL SELYS JUST TO THE COOL SIDE OF THE FRONT...SHEAR WILL FAVOR ORGANIZED/SEVERE STORMS. ALONG WITH HAIL POTENTIAL...STORMS SHIFTING QUICKLY SEWD WILL LIKELY BE CAPABLE OF PRODUCING DAMAGING WINDS -- ESPECIALLY IF ONE OR MORE MCS/S EVOLVE WITHIN THE LARGER AREA OF CONVECTION. DURING THE EVENING...SOME DIURNAL INCREASE IN SLY LOW-LEVEL FLOW MAY ASSIST IN MAINTAINING ROBUST CONVECTION INTO THE EVENING...BEFORE DIURNAL EFFECTS MITIGATE SEVERE WEATHER POTENTIAL OVERNIGHT.

sections.title: GREAT LAKES/MIDWEST/OH VALLEY AREA
sections.text: WHILE ONGOING CONVECTION EARLY IN THE PERIOD ACROSS THE OH VALLEY/UPPER GREAT LAKES REGION COMPLICATES THE FORECAST...IT APPEARS THAT STORMS SHOULD INCREASE INTO THE AFTERNOON ACROSS THIS REGION AS HEATING/DESTABILIZATION IN THE WAKE OF AN INITIAL WAVE OF STORMS OCCURS. MODELS SUGGEST THAT BY LATE AFTERNOON...STORMS SHOULD BE GROWING UPSCALE INTO AN MCS...CROSSING LOWER MI/IL/INDIANA/OH BEFORE WEAKENING ALONG THE W SLOPES OF THE APPALACHIANS DURING THE EVENING. UNTIL THEN...ROUGHLY UNIDIRECTIONAL FLOW ALOFT INCREASING TO AROUND 40 KT AT H5 WILL SUPPORT PROGRESSIVE STORMS...WITH ASSOCIATED THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS IN ADDITION TO HAIL. ..GOSS/GRAMS.. 08/07/2011

sections.title: OH VALLEY REGION THROUGH THIS EVENING
sections.text: GRADUAL WEAKENING OF THE SUBTROPICAL RIDGE OVER THE SRN PLAINS WILL CONTINUE...WHILE N OF THE RIDGE A BELT OF MODERATE WLY/WNWLY MIDLEVEL FLOW WILL EXIST FROM THE NRN ROCKIES ACROSS THE CENTRAL PLAINS TO THE OH VALLEY AND MID ATLANTIC REGION. A PRIMARY EMBEDDED SHORTWAVE TROUGH WITHIN THIS FLOW STREAM WILL PROGRESS EWD FROM NW IL THIS MORNING TO NW OH/SE LOWER MI THIS EVENING. IN ADVANCE OF THIS WAVE...A WEAK SURFACE LOW IS EXPECTED TO MOVE EWD FROM SW ONTARIO THIS MORNING TO NRN NY BY AFTERNOON AND THE GULF OF MAINE EARLY MONDAY. AN ASSOCIATED COLD FRONT WILL MOVE SEWD ACROSS THE GREAT LAKES IN THE WAKE OF THE WEAK LOW. THUNDERSTORM CLUSTERS ARE ONGOING FROM THE OH/WV/KY BORDER WSWWD ACROSS KY/TN IN ASSOCIATION WITH LOW-LEVEL WAA...WHILE SEPARATE CLUSTERS OF STORMS PERSIST OVER SRN WI IN THE ZONE OF ASCENT IMMEDIATELY DOWNSTREAM FROM THE ERN IA/NW IL SHORTWAVE TROUGH. SOME FORM OF THIS WI CONVECTION COULD PERSIST AND SPREAD EWD INTO LOWER MI TODAY...WITH ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT POSSIBLE FARTHER S INTO INDIANA ALONG A REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM OVERNIGHT CONVECTION THAT WEAKENED ACROSS NRN IL. THOUGH MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL BE RATHER MODEST...MLCAPE COULD INCREASE TO 1500-2000

sections.title: PLAINS AREA THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT
sections.text: THE WRN EXTENT OF THE COLD FRONT CROSSING THE GREAT LAKES WILL BECOME QUASI-STATIONARY ACROSS KS/NEB THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING. ADDITIONAL EMBEDDED SPEED MAXIMA WILL TRANSLATE ESEWD FROM THE NRN ROCKIES TO THE PLAINS ABOVE THE FRONTAL ZONE...WHILE A SEPARATE SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVES ESEWD TO SE MANITOBA AND NW ND BY THE END OF THE PERIOD. A BELT OF 65-70 F BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS AND STRONG SURFACE HEATING ALONG/S OF THE FRONT WILL CONTRIBUTE TO AFTERNOON MLCAPE VALUES OF 2500-3500 J/KG. MEANWHILE...DEEP-LAYER VERTICAL SHEAR WILL BE SUPPORTIVE OF SUPERCELLS AS A RESULT OF ELY/ESELY SURFACE FLOW BENEATH 30-50 KT WLY MID-UPPER FLOW. PRESENT INDICATIONS ARE THAT SCATTERED SEVERE STORMS WILL DEVELOP BY MID-LATE AFTERNOON ALONG THE FRONT IN NRN KS/NEB...AS WELL AS IN THE UPSLOPE FLOW REGIME EXTENDING NWWD INTO THE HIGH PLAINS/BLACK HILLS AREA. THE INITIAL STORMS COULD BE SUPERCELLS WITH LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS...AND PERHAPS AN ISOLATED TORNADO. UPSCALE GROWTH INTO ONE OR MORE CLUSTERS IS PROBABLE THIS EVENING INTO EARLY TONIGHT...WITH CONVECTION EXPECTED TO SPREAD ESEWD ALONG THE FRONT INTO NE KS/SE NEB/NW MO WITH A CONTINUING RISK FOR DAMAGING WINDS.

sections.title: ERN PA/MID ATLANTIC THIS AFTERNOON
sections.text: SOME DEBRIS CLOUDS WILL BE POSSIBLE THIS AFTERNOON FROM THE REMNANTS OF THE OH VALLEY CONVECTION...BUT SATELLITE IMAGERY SUGGESTS THAT SURFACE HEATING SHOULD BE SUFFICIENT TO RESULT IN AFTERNOON MLCAPE VALUES AOA 1500 J/KG FROM VA NWD INTO ERN PA. SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS SHOULD DEVELOP OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN BY EARLY AFTERNOON AND THEN SPREAD EWD/SEWD THROUGH THE REMAINDER OF THE AFTERNOON. MODEST MIDLEVEL FLOW AND DEEP-LAYER VERTICAL SHEAR COULD SUPPORT A FEW ORGANIZED MULTICELL CLUSTERS WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR ISOLATED STRONG/DAMAGING WINDS. ..THOMPSON/ROGERS.. 08/07/2011

sections.title: PLAINS AREA
sections.text: MESOSCALE BUBBLE HIGH/COLD POOL HAS SPREAD SWD THROUGH THE OZARKS LATE THIS MORNING WITH TRAILING BOUNDARY WWD INTO CNTRL KS. SYNOPTIC BOUNDARY WAS SITUATED FARTHER TO THE N...FROM A MESOSCALE LOW OVER NWRN IND THROUGH CNTRL PORTIONS OF IA/NEB THEN NWWD INTO NERN WY. ELEVATED STORM CLUSTERS HAVE DEVELOPED ALONG THE NEB/KS BORDER IN A REGION OF WEAK WLY H85-H7 WINDS THAT ARE IMPINGING ON THE AFOREMENTIONED COLD POOL. 12Z TOP SOUNDING EXHIBITED VERY STEEP MID-LVL LAPSE RATES AND LARGE HAIL IS LIKELY WITH THESE STORMS. CONCERN IS THAT STORMS WILL EVENTUALLY ROOT INTO A RECOVERING AIR MASS ESE ACROSS NERN/ECNTRL KS AND NRN MO THIS AFTN. NEAR 70 DEG F SFC DEW POINTS SHOULD SURGE NWD AGAIN AHEAD OF THE DEVELOPING COMPLEX OF STORMS AND GIVEN THE MAGNITUDE OF LAPSE RATES...THERE IS A HIGH LIKELIHOOD OF MAINTAINING STORMS. VWP/PROFILER DATA INDICATE 40-50 KT WLY FLOW MID-LVL WINDS...INDICATING SUFFICIENT VERTICAL SHEAR FOR SUPERCELL/BOWING STRUCTURES CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL. 30 PERCENT RISK OF LARGE HAIL/SVR WINDS HAVE BEEN EXPANDED SEWD INTO PARTS OF NRN MO. MEANWHILE...ATTENTION WILL FOCUS FARTHER W AS A MID-LEVEL WAVE OVER WY APPROACHES THE HIGH PLAINS. WHILE THE DEVELOPING MC

sections.title: MID-ATLANTIC TO CNTRL/ERN CAROLINAS
sections.text: TWO SUB-SYNOPTIC VORT MAXIMA OVER WV AND ERN TN WILL CONTINUE EWD INTO VA/NC THIS AFTN/EVE. VSBL SATL SHOWS CONSIDERABLE DIABATIC HEATING OCCURRING ALONG/E OF THE APPALACHIAN FOOTHILLS FROM ERN VA SWD INTO CNTRL NC. 12Z SOUNDINGS EXHIBIT HIGH PRECIPITABLE WATER VALUES WITH WEAK FLOW ALOFT...SUGGESTING HVY DOWNPOURS WILL BE PRIMARY TSTM THREATS. HOWEVER...UPSTREAM VWP CLOSER TO THE VORT CENTERS SUGGEST AT LEAST 35 KTS OF WLY MID-LVL FLOW WILL BEGIN TO SPREAD ACROSS THE MOUNTAINS AND ATOP THE VERY MOIST/MODESTLY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT. CONGLOMERATING MULTICELL STORM CLUSTERS WILL LIKELY PRODUCE AT LEAST ISOLD WET MICROBURSTS...WITH STRONGEST DCAPE VALUES GENERALLY FROM NCNTRL NC INTO ERN VA. ACTIVITY WILL DIMINISH DURING THE EVENING.

sections.title: MIDWEST/OH VLY REGION
sections.text: PRIMARY CHANGES TO OTLK WERE TO TRIM NRN EDGE OF SLGT RISK IN THE MIDWEST/OH VLY. PASSAGE OF A WEAK MID-LEVEL IMPULSE HAS ALLOWED A MORE STABLE LOW-LEVEL BOUNDARY LAYER TO SLIP SWD TO THE I-70 CORRIDOR IN CNTRL OH...THEN ARCING NWWD INTO THE MCV OVER NWRN IND. WHILE STRONG STORMS WERE ASSOCIATED WITH THE MCV...ACTIVITY SHOULD WEAKEN AND/OR REMAIN BELOW SVR LIMITS ACROSS SRN LWR MI WITH GUSTY WINDS AND ISOLD HAIL. MEANWHILE...AIR MASS WILL BE RECOVERING ACROSS CNTRL/NRN IND AND AT LEAST WRN OH WHERE MID-LATE AFTN MLCAPES WILL RANGE FROM 1500-2500 J/KG. 40-45 KTS OF WLY MID-LEVEL FLOW AND GENERALLY UNIDIRECTIONAL FLOW REGIME THROUGH THE COLUMN WILL YIELD MODESTLY FAST MOVING LINE SEGMENTS WITH DAMAGING WINDS/LARGE HAIL POSSIBLE. ACTIVITY MAY SPREAD AS FAR E AS THE MID-OH VLY/KY BY EARLY EVENING...BUT DIMINISH BY LATE EVENING. ..RACY/HURLBUT.. 08/07/2011

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS DELMARVA REGION
sections.text: ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS SRN/ERN AR EWD INTO FAR SRN TN/NRN MS...

sections.title: ERN AR/WRN TN AND NRN MS
sections.text: DESPITE WEAK SHEAR...PRESENCE OF EWD MOVING MCV COMBINED WITH HOT AND UNSTABLE AIR MASS...WEAKLY ORGANIZED STORMS SHOULD SPREAD/DEVELOP EWD ACROSS THE REGION THIS AFTERNOON...WITH THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT FAVORABLE FOR A FEW SEVERE GUSTS. REFERENCE MD 1883.

sections.title: NC NWD INTO SERN PA/NJ
sections.text: ALTHOUGH STORM SCALE MODELS HAVE BEEN CONSISTENT IN DEVELOPING CONVECTION IN NC...LATEST SATELLITE PICTURES SHOW STRONG SUBSIDENCE...EVEN CU HAVE BEEN SLOW TO DEVELOP. HOWEVER...STORMS HAVE DEVELOPED OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF WV/VA AND SERN PA/NJ. SUFFICIENT SHEAR...HEATING AND INSTABILITY FOR STORMS TO PRODUCE A FEW DAMAGING WIND EVENTS.

sections.title: TX/OK PANHANDLE AND SWRN OK
sections.text: STORMS HAVE RECENTLY DEVELOPED ALONG NRN EDGE OF DENSER CLOUD BAND. LOOPING VISIBLE IMAGERY SUGGESTS A SWD MOVING WAVE MAY HAVE ALSO AIDED INITIATION. WHILE THE THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT MAY SUPPORT A FEW PULSE TYPE WIND EVENTS...STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO MOVE RANDOMLY AND THE SEVERE SHOULD BE VERY ISOLATED IN NATURE...REF MD 1884. REST OF FORECAST ON TRACK. ..IMY.. 08/07/2011 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1126 AM CDT SUN AUG 07 2011/

sections.title: SD/NEB SEWD ACROSS THE MID MS/LOWER OH/TN VALLEY REGION
sections.text: SEVERAL CLUSTERS OF STRONG/SEVERE CONVECTION ARE ONGOING ATTM FROM THE NRN HIGH PLAINS REGION SEWD INTO THE TN VALLEY AREA. ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND HAIL WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE ACROSS SERN MO/NERN AR AS A CLUSTER OF STORMS MOVES SEWD THROUGH MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIRMASS...AND ACROSS NERN MS/NRN AL WHERE A SECOND CONVECTIVE CLUSTER CONTINUES TO SURGE SWD THROUGH A SIMILARLY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT. MORE SUBSTANTIAL SEVERE THREAT IS INDICATED FARTHER NW INTO THE SD/NEB/KS REGION...WHERE WARM/MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER BENEATH STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES IS CONTRIBUTING TO A LARGE AREA OF MODERATE TO STRONG INSTABILITY. A DEVELOPING SSWLY LOW-LEVEL JET BENEATH MORE ROBUST /40-PLUS KT/ WLYS AT MID LEVELS WILL SUPPORT SUPERCELL ORGANIZATION...BUT WITH TIME EXPECT UPSCALE GROWTH INTO ONE OR MORE MCS/S -- THE MOST SUBSTANTIAL OF WHICH IS LIKELY TO SHIFT QUICKLY ESEWD ACROSS THE MID MO VALLEY REGION THIS EVENING/OVERNIGHT. GIVEN THE LIKELIHOOD FOR MORE WIDESPREAD DAMAGING WINDS WITH THIS ANTICIPATED CONVECTIVE SYSTEM...WILL MAINTAIN HIGHER-PROBABILITY SEVERE WIND FORECAST.

sections.title: THE MIDWEST/MID AND UPPER OH VALLEY REGION
sections.text: SCATTERED SHOWERS AND THUNDERSTORMS CONTINUE ACROSS THE MIDWEST REGION AS AN ASSOCIATED/COMPLEX UPPER TROUGH CROSSES THE GREAT LAKES REGION. A GENERAL DECREASE IN CONVECTIVE INTENSITY IS EXPECTED OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS...WITH THE LOSS OF DIURNAL HEATING. IN THE MEAN TIME...ISOLATED DAMAGING GUSTS AND MARGINAL HAIL -- PARTICULARLY WITH MORE ORGANIZED STORM CLUSTERS CROSSING BOTH NRN INDIANA AND THE WV VICINITY -- CAN BE EXPECTED. ..GOSS.. 08/08/2011
